items.corrections: LK-99 synthesis and transport testing found no superconductivity in the tested samples; no exact ambient-pressure, room-temperature superconductor was demonstrated. The bounded search did not substantiate the exact capability. A negative result for one candidate does not prove impossibility.

ITER describes tungsten selection and ongoing prototype qualification tests, establishing a materials-development challenge. This page does not report successful qualification or lifetime performance under all reactor conditions.

A multilayer solid-state battery design reported no dendrite penetration and long cycling in its specific test configuration. Not a generally dendrite-free electrolyte across materials, cell sizes, manufacturing and operating conditions.

Large-area aligned graphene growth/assembly is being achieved, but experiments found defective joins in one Cu(111)/sapphire process. Defect-free macroscopic graphene or CNT assembly at arbitrary scale is not demonstrated.
A visible-light cloak paper reports concealing a large sphere from human sight in three orthogonal directions. No broadband, perfect or all-viewpoint optical cloak is demonstrated.

A directly relevant room-temperature thermoelectric materials paper was found, but the actual journal page was unreadable. The claimed ZT >5–10 material remains unassessed from readable sources in this bounded search.

One recombinant spidroin approach produced fibers matching natural dragline spider silk on reported mechanical metrics. No industrial-scale throughput, cost, durable production line, or superior fiber is shown.

A relevant primary coating study was identified, but the publisher page was blocked and could not be inspected. No verified evidence here for the full durable, super-self-cleaning, self-healing structural coating.

A specific artificial photosynthesis setup reported 20.1% solar-to-fuel efficiency over 28 hours. Not industrial scale, long-term durability, or a general catalyst for efficient artificial photosynthesis.

Computational candidates and a room-temperature spin-orbit switching result in one topological-insulator hybrid indicate narrow progress. The predicted monolayers were not experimentally validated, and the hybrid-device result is not a stable scalable quantum material.

notes: All nine used URLs independently reopened; actual titles and relevant passages match.
Corrected ITER overstatement: undergo qualification testing does not mean successfully qualified. MAS-02 narrowed to goal-supported.
RSC original PDF request resolves to readable article abstract; stored actual resolved URL and replaced normalized formula pseudoquote. MDPI formula pseudoquote replaced with contiguous exact text.
Topological-insulator presentation is an author conference abstract; computational candidates remain predictions. LK-99 negative test does not prove general impossibility.

sourceChecks.excerpt: with an 82 per cent capacity retention after 10,000 cycles at a 20C rate

sourceChecks.limitations: This is a bounded human-view demonstration, not a perfect all-angle, broadband visible cloak; the paper itself says all-viewpoint concealment is extremely challenging. Independently reopened source snapshot; live availability not asserted.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Authors report a large-scale spherical object hidden from human observers along three orthogonal viewing directions using a 3D refractive-index design.

sourceChecks.excerpt: Fibers spun from our synthetic spidroins are the first to fully replicate the mechanical performance of their natural counterparts
sourceChecks.limitations: The paper does not demonstrate industrial-scale continuous manufacturing, cost, or volume; do not interpret the title as scale evidence. Independently reopened source snapshot; live availability not asserted.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Researchers produced large recombinant spidroins and spun fibers matching natural dragline silk on reported strength, modulus, extensibility and toughness measures.

sourceChecks.excerpt: was demonstrated experimentally for 28 hours in the absence of a DC/DC converter.
sourceChecks.limitations: A specific lab system and 28-hour result; not industrial-scale deployment or durable, broadly applicable artificial photosynthesis. Independently reopened source snapshot; live availability not asserted.
